'''Liudas Mažylis''' (born 19 May 1954) is a Lithuanian politician who is a [[Member of the European Parliament]] for the [[Homeland Union]].<ref name="europa" />

Mažylis first served as an MEP from July 2019 to July 2024.<ref name="europa">{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/197841|title=Home &#124; Liudas Mažylis &#124; MEPs &#124; European Parliament|website=europarl.europa.eu|access-date=21 December 2019}}</ref> He was not directly re-elected [[2024 European Parliament election in Lithuania|in 2024]], but replaced [[Andrius Kubilius]] after his nomination as a [[European Commissioner]] in December 2024.<ref name="EPP Group">{{cite web |title=Liudas MAŽYLIS |url=https://www.eppgroup.eu/who-we-are/our-members/liudas-mazylis |website=EPP Group |access-date=7 December 2024}}</ref>
